titleEn: Surrey Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real Prices From $25,000
titleZh: 素里厨房装修费用2026：真实价格从$25,000起
contentEn:
Surrey homeowners spend between $25,000 and $38,000 on a kitchen renovation in 2026, with most projects falling in the $28,000–$31,000 range. The final cost depends on cabinet scope, countertop material, whether plumbing or electrical work is needed, and the size of the space.

Reno Stars has completed four Surrey kitchen projects ranging from a $25,000 baseline remodel to a $38,000 full custom-cabinet renovation. Here is what those projects actually cost and what drove each price.

What Determines Your Surrey Kitchen Renovation Cost

Three factors account for most of the spread between a $25,000 and a $38,000 kitchen in Surrey. First, cabinetry is the largest single line item — stock cabinets run $150–$300 per linear foot, custom cabinets $400–$800 per linear foot. Second, countertops — laminate ($20–$40/sq ft) versus quartz ($60–$120/sq ft) can add $3,000–$6,000 to the total. Third, layout changes that require moving plumbing or gas lines add $2,000–$5,000 per affected fixture.

Surrey Kitchen Renovation Project Prices

All prices below include materials, labour, and GST. They cover the scope described — not extras like moving walls or upgrading electrical panels.

Strata and Permit Requirements for Surrey Kitchens

Surrey is part of the City of Surrey, which follows BC Building Code 9.36 for residential renovations. A kitchen renovation permit is required when you move plumbing fixtures, alter structural elements, or exceed $5,000 in value — which is the threshold for requiring a building permit in Surrey. Most cosmetic kitchen renos (cabinet swap, countertop replacement, flooring) do not require a permit if the layout stays unchanged.

If you are in a strata property, your strata corporation may require design approval before you start — this is a separate process from the City permit and can take 4–8 weeks. Reno Stars handles both the City of Surrey permit application and strata approval coordination as part of our standard project process.

How Long Does a Surrey Kitchen Renovation Take?

Based on three completed Surrey kitchen projects, the timeline is consistently 4–5 weeks from demolition to final inspection. This assumes no layout changes that require structural work. If you are moving the sink or stove location, add 1–2 weeks for plumbing and electrical permit processing.

Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule before work begins, including confirmed delivery dates for cabinets and countertops from Surrey-area suppliers.

Surrey Kitchen Trends 2026

Surrey homeowners favour clean contemporary aesthetics in 2026, with flat-panel (shaker) cabinets in white or light grey, quartz countertops in white or marble-look, and matte black or brushed nickel hardware. Open-concept layouts that remove a peninsula or partial wall are a popular scope change, though these require a structural engineer letter and a City of Surrey permit.

For more detail on how Surrey compares to neighbouring cities, see our Richmond kitchen renovation cost guide and our Langley kitchen renovation cost guide.

Surrey Kitchen Renovation FAQ

What is the average cost of a Surrey kitchen renovation in 2026?

The average Surrey kitchen renovation in 2026 costs between $28,000 and $31,000 for a mid-range kitchen with custom cabinets and quartz countertops. Budget projects start around $25,000; premium full-custom renovations reach $38,000. All prices include materials, labour, and GST.

Does Surrey require a permit for kitchen renovation?

Surrey requires a building permit when plumbing fixtures are moved, structural walls are altered, or the project value exceeds $5,000. Cosmetic work such as cabinet replacement, countertop swapping, and flooring installation within the existing layout does not require a permit. Check with the City of Surrey building division if you are unsure.

How long does a Surrey kitchen renovation take?

A standard Surrey kitchen renovation with no layout changes takes 4–5 weeks from demolition to final inspection. Projects that move plumbing or electrical fixtures add 1–2 weeks for permit processing.

Do strata properties in Surrey need approval for kitchen renovation?

Yes. If your property is a strata unit, your strata corporation must approve the renovation design before work begins. This is a separate process from the City of Surrey building permit and can take 4–8 weeks. Reno Stars coordinates both processes.

What is included in Reno Stars kitchen renovation quotes?

Reno Stars quotes include demolition, all materials (cabinets, countertops, flooring, fixtures), labour, permit fees, and a pre-project walkthrough. Quotes are fixed-price, not time-and-materials, so the number you see is the number on your invoice.
contentZh:
2026年，素里房主的厨房装修费用通常在25,000至38,000加元之间，大多数项目集中在28,000至31,000加元。最终费用取决于橱柜规模、台面材料、是否需要管道或电气工程，以及空间大小。

聚星装修已完成四个素里厨房项目，价格从25,000加元的基线翻新到38,000加元的全定制橱柜装修。以下是这些项目的实际成本及价格构成。

影响素里厨房装修费用的因素

三个因素造成25,000加元与38,000加元厨房之间的差异。首先，橱柜是最大的单项支出——成品橱柜每线性英尺150至300加元，定制橱柜每线性英尺400至800加元。其次，台面——层压板（每平方英尺20至40加元）与人造石英石（每平方英尺60至120加元）的差异可使总费用增加3,000至6,000加元。第三，布局变更（需要移动管道或煤气管道）每个受影响的固定装置增加2,000至5,000加元。

素里厨房装修项目价格

以下价格均包含材料、人工和GST。不含拆除墙壁或升级配电板等额外项目。

项目预算范围工期主要范围
素里厨房装修$25,000–$30,0004–5周成品橱柜、层压板台面、无布局变更
定制橱柜素里厨房装修$29,000–$31,0004–5周定制橱柜、石英石台面、相同布局
现代风格素里厨房装修$35,000–$38,0004–5周全定制橱柜、石英石台面、设备升级

想要规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？立即联系聚星装修获取免费、无义务报价。

素里厨房装修的分契物业和许可证要求

素里市遵循BC省建筑规范9.36。移动管道装置、改变结构构件或项目价值超过5,000加元时，需要厨房装修许可证。如果布局保持不变，大多数 Cosmetic 厨房装修（更换橱柜、台面更换、地面铺设）不需要许可证。

如果您是分契物业，您的分契公司可能需要在工程开始前获得设计批准——这是与市府许可证分开的流程，可能需要4至8周。聚星装修涵盖素里市许可证申请和分契批准协调的整个流程。

素里厨房装修需要多长时间？

根据三个已完成的素里厨房项目，时间表始终为4至5周，从拆除到最终检查。如果需要移动水槽或炉灶位置，则需为管道和电气许可证处理增加1至2周。

聚星装修在工程开始前提供详细的项目时间表，包括素里地区供应商橱柜和台面的确认交付日期。

2026年素里厨房趋势

2026年，素里房主偏好简洁的当代美学，包括白色或浅灰色平面（雪弗尔）橱柜、白色或大理石纹石英石台面，以及哑光黑色或拉丝镍硬件。拆除半岛或部分墙壁的开放式概念布局是常见的范围变更，但这些需要结构工程师函和素里市许可证。

素里厨房装修常见问题

2026年素里厨房装修的平均费用是多少？

2026年素里厨房装修的平均费用在28,000至31,000加元之间，适用于带有定制橱柜和石英石台面的中档厨房。预算项目起价约25,000加元；高端全定制装修可达38,000加元。所有价格均包含材料、人工和GST。

素里厨房装修需要许可证吗？

移动管道装置、改变结构墙或项目价值超过5,000加元时，素里需要建筑许可证。Cosmetic 工作（如橱柜更换、台面更换，地板铺设）在现有布局内不需要许可证。如有疑问，请联系素里市建设部门。

素里厨房装修需要多长时间？

无布局变更的标准素里厨房装修从拆除到最终检查需要4至5周。移动管道或电气装置的项目需额外1至2周的许可证处理时间。

素里的分契物业需要批准厨房装修吗？

是的。如果您的物业是分契单位，您的分契公司必须在工程开始前批准装修设计。这是与素里市建筑许可证分开的流程，可能需要4至8周。聚星装修协调两个流程。
